materiality.rationale: FlashInfer v0.6.17 describes production-oriented MoE expert parallelism, SM12x FP4 fixes, unified MXFP4 APIs, and Kimi K3/MiniMax-M3 decode coverage in vLLM; it matters as a low-level W33 serving and precision-support change, with release-note claims source-attributed.

profile_annotations.why_this_issue: This candidate matters to the infrastructure view of the issue because expert parallelism, FP4/MXFP4 handling, and decode coverage determine whether new MoE models can be served efficiently in the surrounding stack.
